commun.excel: Downloads the list shown as an Excel file, with current filters.
commun.pdf: Generates a PDF of the list shown, ready to print or send.
commun.importer: Adds data in bulk from an Excel file (use the template first).
commun.telechargerModele: Downloads the Excel template to fill in before importing.
commun.itineraire: Opens directions to this place in Google Maps.
commun.receptionner: Confirms receipt: the amount or goods are added to the destination.

clients.nouveauClient: Creates a customer record. GPS position is captured automatically if you are at the customer's.

portefeuille.appliquer: Assigns the checked customers to the chosen sales rep's portfolio.

table.modifier: Edits the record: contact details, GPS, photo, prices, assigned rep.
table.creditTitle: The customer has a credit: click to refund it.

commandes.nouvelleCommande: Records a customer order to be delivered later.

detail.confirmer: Confirms the order: it goes to preparation at the warehouse.
detail.demarrerPreparation: Tells the warehouse the order is being prepared.
detail.enregistrerLivraison: Confirms delivery: the sale is created and stock deducted.
detail.annulerCommande: Cancels the order (it stays in the history).
detail.facturePropforma: Generates a proforma invoice to send before delivery.

form.ajouterArticle: Adds a product line to the order.

ventes.nouvelleVente: Records a sale: stock is deducted and, on credit, a receivable is created.

detail.annulerVenteAvoir: Cancels the sale with a credit note: stock is restored, the sale stays traced.
detail.bonLivraison: Generates the delivery note for the customer to sign.
detail.partager: Sends the invoice to the customer (WhatsApp, e-mail…).

form.ajouterArticle: Adds a product line to the sale.

stock.nouveauProduit: Creates a product in the catalogue (price, category, alert threshold).

inventaire.bouton: Starts a physical count: count, the app computes the differences.

table.ajusterStock: Records a stock entry or exit with its reason.
table.transfererDepots: Moves goods from one warehouse to another.

journalcaisse.nouvelleDemande: Requests a disbursement: it must be approved, then paid.
journalcaisse.retourFonds: Records money returned to the till (balance of an advance).
journalcaisse.transfert: Sends money to another till or to a bank.
journalcaisse.approvisionnement: Records money coming into the till.
journalcaisse.versBanque: Deposits till money at the bank.

inventaire.nouveau: Count notes and coins: the app compares with the theoretical balance.

journalcaisse.refuser: Rejects the request with a reason.
journalcaisse.corriger: Corrects an entry with a traced reversing entry.

banques.nouveauTransfert: Transfers money between bank and till.
banques.nouveauDecaissement: Records money going out of the bank.

tournees.nouvelleTournee: Schedules a route of visits, manually or with AI.
tournees.creerTourneeOptimisee: Creates the route: the visit order is computed for the shortest trip.

ia.proposer: AI picks the customers to visit and spreads visits over the period.
ia.creerTournees: Creates all routes of the suggested schedule.
ia.retirer: Removes this customer from the schedule.

detail.marquerVisitee: Validates the visit (GPS checked) and opens the visit report.
detail.meGuider: Starts navigation to the next customer.
detail.retirer: Removes this customer from the route.

validation.approuver: Approves the route: the rep can start the visits.
validation.refuser: Rejects the route: it is deleted, the rep can propose another.

tournees.ajouter: Adds a customer to this route.

utilisateurs.inviterCollaborateur: Creates an account for a team member and sends an invitation.
utilisateurs.regenererPin: Generates a new temporary PIN for this member.
utilisateurs.reinitialiserMdp: Generates a temporary password the member must change.
utilisateurs.annulerInvitation: Cancels the invitation not yet accepted.

messagerie.nouveauCanal: Creates a group chat (e.g. the whole sales team).
messagerie.nouvelleConversation: Starts a private chat with a colleague.

mouvementsstock.joindreJustificatif: Attaches a photo or document (exit slip, invoice…) to this movement.
mouvementsstock.voirJustificatif: Opens the file attached to this movement.
mouvementsstock.remplacer: Replaces a file attached by mistake. The old one is kept for audit, with the reason.
mouvementsstock.envoyer: Uploads the file. Photos are reduced automatically to go faster.

objectifs.nouvelObjectif: Sets a sales target (amount or quantity) over a period.
objectifs.unePersonne: Target for a sales rep or team lead.
objectifs.leBureau: Target for sales made at the office.

depots.nouveauDepot: Adds a warehouse and its manager.

creances.soldeReporte: Records a customer debt from before DistribPro.

stockcommercial.nouvelleSortie: Hands goods to a sales rep for field sales.

versements.enregistrer: Records money handed in by a sales rep.

plancomptable.nouveauCompte: Adds an account to the chart of accounts.

notesutilisation.exporterPdf: Exports the usage notes as PDF.
